title: Queued notifications
text: Shows a few toasts at once and queues the rest until there is room.

title: Timers that wait
text: Auto-dismiss pauses while users hover or focus the toasts.

title: Keyboard shortcut
text: A hotkey moves focus to the newest toast and back to where users were.

title: Optional action
text: One action button per toast, such as Undo, closes it when pressed.

title: Six positions
text: Place the region in any corner or centered at the top or bottom.
